item.title: github: Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps generally available
item.description:
Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps Services to GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency are now generally available. The feature lets organizations migrate repositories while teams continue working.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: New built-in Azure automation connectors in Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Azure Logic Apps Automation now has new built-in Azure automation connectors in public preview. The connectors support workflow automation across GitHub, Azure DevOps, and Azure management services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app, Microsoft Ignite releases
item.description:
GitHub released updates for the Copilot app at Microsoft Ignite, adding support for Azure DevOps repositories, GitHub Enterprise Server, and use in the browser. The post says Copilot is intended to work where you already work.

  • Source: GitHub
